scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: biome check . && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend -- --max-warnings=0
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write . && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test:unit -w frontend
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov -w backend && npm run test:unit -w frontend -- --coverage
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w backend && npm run test:e2e -w frontend
